name: Scream And Run [VERITY]
desc:
You’re trapped inside a school after dark, and you’re not alone. The Cat in the Hat is hunting you.

Search through abandoned classrooms and backpacks to find the hidden keys you need to unlock the exit.

Launch Game Modes!
Hide And Seek
Free Roam
Escape

Controls
Run - Shift
Crouch - C
Crawl - C
Slide - Shift + C
Flashlight - F
